verdict.rationale: Persona's Workflows feature automates repetitive decisions on events, and Reports can explicitly be scheduled to run at regular intervals (e.g., monthly/yearly watchlist checks), which is a genuine recurring-job capability. However, this is narrowly scoped to identity/report re-checks rather than a general-purpose recurring workflow/job scheduler an AI-native user could apply broadly. Missing for 10: a generic cron-like scheduling API for arbitrary workflows, documentation of scheduling cadence/configuration options, and evidence of AI-agent-triggered or -managed recurring jobs.
